Background arrival monitoring needs precise location. Allow precise location first. With approximate location, Campus Companion provides timetable-only guidance.

Campus Companion uses background location to detect arrival near your class building while the app is closed. In Settings, open Permissions, then Location, and choose “%1$s”. This is optional. You can keep using timetable guidance and GPS arrival while foreground sensing is running.

Campus Companion uses background location to detect arrival near your class building while the app is closed. Choose “Allow all the time” in the next Android permission dialog. This is optional. You can keep using timetable guidance and GPS arrival while foreground sensing is running.
